name: genudo-ai
description: Genudo — the enterprise operating platform for autonomous AI Employees (Sales, Customer Support, Rose Quality Control & Operations, and WhatsApp Campaign Sender) across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and Web.

plugins.name: genudo
plugins.description: Genudo — the platform to build and manage an autonomous AI Workforce (Sales, Support, Rose QC, Campaign Sender) with ecosystem tool detection (Meta Ads, Google Sheets, Lovable, Zoho Desk, Zapier). 27 skills, 6 agents, and the Genudo connector built in — sign in through your browser, no token to paste.

plugins.name: genudo-no-connector
plugins.description: Genudo skills + agents WITHOUT a bundled MCP connector — for when you connect Genudo yourself: per project (claude mcp add --transport http genudo https://api.genudo.ai/mcp --scope project), as a custom connector in Claude web/desktop settings, or via the genudo.mcpb extension. 27 skills and 6 agents.
